evidence: It was observed even for GaAs ALE growth on a GaAs substrate, probably due to the difference of the carrier concentration, as shown in the upper part of Fig. 5. The amplitude of this oscillation increased very much by adding AlCl3, as shown in the lower part of Fig. 5, so we hoped that Al was contained in the ALE-grown layer. Actually SIMS analysis indicated Al incorporation in the grown layer, as shown in Fig. 6, especially at the portion where the AlCl3 was added, though we could not see any Raman shift corresponding to the Al-As bond, probably due to a too-low Al content and a too-thin AlGaAs layer.
